entities.summary: Sergei Konstantinovitch Pankejeff was a Russian aristocrat from Odesa in the Russian Empire. Pankejeff is best known for being a patient of Sigmund Freud, who gave him the pseudonym of the Wolf Man to protect his identity, after a dream Pankejeff had of a tree full of white wolves.
